solutions.title: Recursive DFS depth
solutions.strategy: Return one plus the larger child depth from each node.

timeComplexity.explanation: Every node is visited exactly once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The recursion stack grows with tree height h.

solutions.title: Iterative BFS levels
solutions.strategy: Count how many breadth-first layers are removed from the queue.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each node enters and leaves the queue once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The queue stores up to the maximum tree width w.
